title: qa(checklist): standing regression between releases — a retest-owed reader over QA-source cards, a touched:SHA selector in checklist-select, and checklist-test §5 cadence for a weekly P0 + api run and a post-publish npm smoke (maintainer, 2026-10-29)
body:
domain:devx#1 · sunhaolin · session_017xRBcVy4VXmkQjn2MGeaWk

Filing gate: **③ a maintainer-directed task.** The maintainer, in session `session_017xRBcVy4VXmkQjn2MGeaWk` on 2026-10-29, asked how to improve periodic testing so platform problems are found in time (verbatim: 「你也可以和我沟通如何完善定期测试，及时发现平台的问题」). Asked which items to land first, they selected all four of the proposed options (option labels as shown to them): 「欠测清单脚本 + 周检」, 「增量选择器 touched:sha」, 「每周 P0 + api 例行」, 「发版后 npm 冒烟例行」. Then: 「这些都应该写到 checklist skills 中」.

Business reason: between releases nothing re-runs the checklist. The measured cost of that gap:
- **Retest debt goes unseen.** SKILL §5 trigger 2 says the seat accepting a QA-extracted fix appends the affected items to the wave anchor's retest list. On the 18.2.0 anchor #25807, 20 such fix cards closed after wave 2's subject (#25934, #26452, #26453, #26459, #26461, #26462, #26463, #26465, #26474, #26477, #26478, #26479, #26480, #26630, #26631, #26632, #26640, #26641, #26642, #26644, #26646, #26707), and its §4 retest list still read "None yet". This session had to derive the list by hand for #27377 §4. A discipline step nobody performs needs a reader that computes it instead.
- **Delta selection is done by hand.** "Which items cite a file changed since the last run" was computed ad hoc for wave 2 and again for wave 3. It found 254 of 352 items touched in 514 commits, and #24840/#24841 used a hand-made `tier1:24681-touched` set. `checklist-select` has no selector for it.
- **The post-publish npm smoke finds the most.** It found 3 FAILs on 18.2.0 (#26629) and 5 on 18.0.0 (#24908) with about 25 cells each: the highest yield per item of any run shape. It only happens when someone remembers to start it.

Reader: the runner and PM sessions that run `checklist-test`, plus the scheduled tasks the dispatching PM session will create once this lands. Those tasks are a weekly regression and a release watch, created by that session as scheduled tasks; they are not repository code.
Dedupe (open AND closed): "checklist-select selector items touched since sha retest owed QA-source fixed cards scheduled weekly checklist run" returns 162 hits, and none of them is a selector, a reader or a cadence. `scripts/qa/qa-rollup.mjs` answers "latest verdict per selector and its staleness". It does not answer "which fixes landed after the verdict that found them". Extend it if that is the cleaner home.

## Deliverables

1. **Retest-owed reader.** A read-only script, `scripts/qa/retest-owed.mjs` or a `qa-rollup` mode.
   - It lists every closed issue whose body carries a `QA-source: #RECORD · area.item · clause` line and whose close time is after the subject commit time of the newest `qa-run` record that judged `area.item`.
   - Output per row: item id, fix card(s), the record that last judged the item, and whether a later record already re-judged it.
   - It has a `--json` mode and an offline `--self-test` in the repository's existing self-test battery style.
   - ⛔ It writes nothing to GitHub.
2. **`touched:SHA` selector in `scripts/checklist-select.mjs`.**
   - It selects the runnable items whose `source[]` paths, or `automated.ref` files, changed in `SHA..HEAD`, comparing paths with the anchor suffix (`#symbol`) stripped.
   - Directory sources match by prefix.
   - It is deterministic and listed in the selector table. Self-test cases go in the existing battery, and its pinned floor rises.
3. **checklist-test SKILL.md cadence text**, in §5 or a new short section.
   - **Weekly regression:** the retest-owed list, plus `touched:` the previous weekly record's subject, plus `priority:P0`, plus `surface:api`, on `main` HEAD. One `qa-run` record per selector. The supersede protocol keeps at most one open weekly record per selector.
   - **Post-publish npm smoke:** after each published release, the `smoke:npm-VERSION` run in the shape of #26629. Its fix cards are re-judged there.
   - This adds a fourth retest trigger to §5's "three and only three". Write it with the ruling cited above. ⛔ Keep the rule that hand-feel reruns are not a trigger.
4. RUNNER.md only if a definition there needs the new selector named.

## Gates to expect

- `node scripts/checklist-select.mjs --self-test` must pass, with its floor raised.
- `node scripts/check-platform-checklist.mjs` stays green.
- The pm-skill line ratchet applies if it covers `checklist-test`, as #26567 had to handle. A net increase needs the ruling id, and the seat posts the ruling on #27377 before ACCEPT.
- `skip-changeset`: no package publishes.

## Out of scope

- Creating the scheduled tasks. The dispatching PM session does that after this lands.
- Any change to verdict rules.
- Any CI workflow.
